_meta.title: Planting 7c: the words a planting makes stale, and the words only a rehearsal may carry
_meta.description: Read by lib/fill-bodies.mjs (keys.mjs fill-bodies --check). stale-words is C2: a body that still carries one of these was sealed before it knew its outcome. lab-words is C5: in a garden whose garden.json says lab-preview: false, no body and no registry text may carry one; in a lab-preview garden, each SKILL.md's integrity line must carry integrity-rehearsal-word. Each entry is matched whole-word and case-insensitive; a space matches any run of whitespace. No per-garden allow-list until a real body needs one (spec Open).
